name: Kintargo Rebel
summary: Whenever the Chelish navy sails into the port, these rebels are quick to appear agreeably subservient in order to conceal their noncompliance and avoid retribution.

features.name: Sophisticated Stealth (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a Kintargo rebel gains a +1 bonus on Knowledge (nobility) checks. In addition, she gains a +1 bonus on Bluff checks to convey a secret message and on Sense Motive checks to discern secret messages. These bonuses increase by 1 every 3 rogue levels thereafter. This ability replaces trap sense.

features.name: Misdirection (Sp)
features.summary: At 4th level, a Kintargo rebel gains the ability to cast misdirection on herself once per day, though instead of choosing an object for the second target, she must choose a creature in range. The caster level for this ability is equal to her class level, and the save DC for this spell is 12 + the Kintargo rebel’s Intelligence modifier. The save DC of this ability increases by 1 if the secondary target is lawful or evil. This ability replaces uncanny dodge.

features.name: Rogue Talents
features.summary: The following rogue talents complement the Kintargo rebel archetype: canny observer APG , charmer APG , false friend ARG , fast getaway APG , honeyed words APG , obfuscate story ARG , and quick disguise ARG .

features.name: Advanced Talents
features.summary: The following advanced rogue talents complement the Kintargo rebel archetype: hard to fool UC , master of disguise APG , skill mastery, slippery mind, and thoughtful reexamining APG .

mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.
